en.headline: Lands Department clears nine presale consents for 3,766 flats
en.dek: Eight of the third-quarter consents cover phased projects in Kai Tak, Chai Wan, Cheung Sha Wan, Yau Tong, Tai Po and To Kwa Wan.
body: The Lands Department said on Wednesday it issued nine consents to sell residential units before completion in the third quarter, covering 3,766 flats. Eight of the consents were for phased developments.

Of those flats, 540 are expected to be completed next year and the remaining 3,226 in 2028, the department said. The projects are in Kai Tak, Chai Wan, Cheung Sha Wan, Yau Tong, Tai Po and To Kwa Wan.

The department also issued one consent to assign in the quarter, for a phased project in Tai Po involving 727 flats. As of 30 September, 34 applications for residential presale consent were still being processed, covering 15,378 units expected to be completed between 2026 and 2030.

Four applications for consent to assign, covering 865 residential units and two non-residential units, were also outstanding, along with four applications for presale consent on non-residential projects.

zh.headline: 地政總署上季批出9份預售同意書 涉3766伙
zh.dek: 第3季批出的住宅預售樓花同意書涵蓋啟德、柴灣、長沙灣、油塘、大埔及土瓜灣，其中3226伙預計2028年落成。
body: 地政總署星期三公布，今年第3季批出9份住宅項目預售樓花同意書，涉及3766個單位，其中8份屬分期發展項目。
署方表示，當中540伙預計明年落成，其餘3226伙料2028年落成。項目位於啟德、柴灣、長沙灣、油塘、大埔及土瓜灣。
第3季亦批出1份轉讓同意書，涉及大埔一個分期發展項目的727個住宅單位。截至9月30日，有待核準的住宅預售樓花同意書申請共34份，涉及15378個單位，預計於2026年至2030年落成。
署方同時正處理4份轉讓同意書申請，涉及865個住宅單位及2個非住宅單位；有待核準的非住宅預售樓花同意書申請則有4份。
